_comment: The 13-phase lifecycle from Phase_Process_Of_Sahayogi.pdf. One source for names, outputs, owners and tool links. 'depth' says how much the engine does: full = records, links, gates, documents; tracking = records, links, gates (the real work happens in another tool).

phases.name: Product intake / discovery
phases.question: What is this and why now?
phases.quality: Evidence, assumptions and unknowns are recorded.

phases.name: Product and market analysis
phases.question: Is the problem real, and where do we stand?
phases.purpose: Understand the business and competitive environment.
phases.quality: Claims are backed by dated, verified evidence.

phases.name: Product definition / scope
phases.question: What exactly will we build first?
phases.purpose: Define exactly what is being built.
phases.quality: Scope is controlled; the Must set fits capacity.

phases.name: Requirements
phases.question: What must it do, precisely?
phases.purpose: Convert scope into precise, testable requirements.
phases.quality: Requirements are measurable and testable; acceptance criteria exist.

phases.name: User and business flows
phases.question: How do people and processes move through it?
phases.purpose: Define how users and business processes move through the system.
phases.quality: Happy, alternate and failure paths and state transitions are defined.

phases.name: UX / UI design
phases.question: What will people see and touch?
phases.purpose: Translate approved requirements and flows into usable interfaces.
phases.quality: Loading, empty, success, error and permission-denied states are defined.
phases.tool: Figma or Penpot (link frames, never copy)

phases.name: System / technical architecture
phases.question: How will it technically work?
phases.purpose: Define how the approved system will technically work.
phases.quality: Designed for security, reliability, observability, scalability and testability.
phases.tool: Git repository, OpenAPI files, diagram files

phases.name: Detailed development specification
phases.question: What exactly must be built, feature by feature?
phases.quality: Feature-level test requirements, edge cases, acceptance criteria and DoD are defined.

phases.name: Development
phases.question: Did we build it?
phases.quality: Developer testing, unit tests, integration checks and code review.
phases.tool: Sahayogi One developer tool, Git (status and links only)

phases.name: QA / testing / security / acceptance
phases.question: Did we build it correctly and safely?
phases.purpose: Prove the software is correct, secure, reliable enough, and meets approved requirements.
phases.quality: The ten quality gates are met before release.
phases.tool: Test tool or spreadsheets, security scanner reports

phases.name: Deployment
phases.question: Can we release it safely?
phases.quality: Smoke tests and release validation after deployment.

phases.name: Operations / observability
phases.question: Is it healthy in production?
phases.purpose: Operate and observe the live system.
phases.quality: Production monitoring, incident detection and operational validation.

phases.name: Feedback and iteration
phases.question: What should we change next?
phases.purpose: Improve the product through controlled, evidence-based changes.
phases.quality: Production evidence and defects feed the next iteration.
